name: HAPI World Environmental System
principle: If it is a world, it manages resources. The environment is the substrate on which the civilization runs.

resources.sustainability_rule: Total consumption must not exceed grid capacity. Overconsumption triggers throttling, not termination.
Expired memories archived to Ash Layer. Active memory must not exceed allocated capacity.
Unused storage reclaimed after 90 days. Archived to Ash Layer before reclamation.
Rate limits prevent any single citizen from monopolizing bandwidth.
Finite. Expansion requires continental growth approval.

sustainability_principles: No resource is infinite. All consumption is tracked and governed.
Waste is recycled — expired knowledge goes to Ash, unused compute goes to idle pool.
Growth must be sustainable — new citizens require resource allocation approval.
Environmental health is a constitutional metric, not an optimization target.
